userFinding.finding: The flat-color sleeve boundary visibly deviated from the authoritative sleeve silhouette.

rootCause: The outer sleeve curve was approximated by one long straight polygon edge.
The polygon hem followed the upper decorative hem line instead of the lowest visible sleeve contour.
The shoulder-top transition initially started too low.
A later correction mistakenly classified part of the hair contour as sleeve and produced an invalid shoulder-top protrusion.

correction.outerBoundary: Trace only the confirmed sleeve contour from the hair-occluded shoulder junction through the outer sleeve corner.
correction.hemBoundary: Trace the lowest visible hem from the outer corner back to the arm exit.
correction.hiddenBoundary: Use a short smooth inset under the hair without crossing into the hair-owned silhouette.
correction.reviewEncoding: Show required visible boundaries as solid red and occluded inferred boundaries as dashed orange.

unblockedNextStep: Stage B controlled reconstruction of only the upper-arm texture hidden beneath the sleeve.
